::: {.callout-note}
## Work in progress

An ONDA Lab working group is currently preparing the Lab analysis pipelines, and
will share them here as soon as they are ready. In the meantime, the public
analysis code listed below is already available.
:::


## ERP Go/No-Go pipeline

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-2}
[![](/files/images/ONDA_waves.png)](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/ERP_Go-Nogo_Pipeline)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}
[ERP_Go-Nogo_Pipeline](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/ERP_Go-Nogo_Pipeline)
collects MATLAB scripts to preprocess EEG data from a Go/No-Go task and extract
the event-related potentials of Go and No-Go trials: cleaning, epoching around
stimulus events and ERP extraction.

_Development stage:_ work in progress

:::

:::


## EEG signal processing

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-2}
[![](/files/images/ONDA_waves.png)](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/EEG_signal_Processing)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}
[EEG_signal_Processing](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/EEG_signal_Processing)
is a set of scripts illustrating basic concepts of signal processing applied to
EEG. Most of the code is inspired by, or adapted from, the code accompanying Mike
Cohen's book *Analyzing Neural Time Series*.

:::

:::


## MEG fingerprinting tutorial

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-2}
[![](/files/images/ONDA_waves.png)](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/fingerprinting_tutorial_omega)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-10}
[fingerprinting_tutorial_omega](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/fingerprinting_tutorial_omega)
contains the Brainstorm scripts accompanying the article *The influence of the
head model on magnetoencephalography-derived functional connectivity
fingerprinting*, and reproduces the three approaches compared in the paper.

:::

:::
